example.install_guide: Open the Dex folder in Kiro. Open the Powers panel, choose Add Custom Power, then Import power from a folder, and select packages/dex-agent-plugin. Name Dex in chat so Kiro wakes the shipped power — the package already lists dex in its keywords. If Dex guessed VS Code, Cursor, or nothing, confirm Kiro in /setup. Hooks are not part of this path. Ubuntu Cloud is not a person opening Kiro. A detection test or green CI is not a live install.
example.install_ui: Powers panel → Add Custom Power → Import power from a folder
example.setup_picker: If auto-detect is empty or names VS Code or Cursor, confirm Kiro in /setup.
